d: Bihar ke hajipur (vaishali) men ek yuvak ki goli markar hatya kie jane aur vardat ke char din bit jane ke bad bhi apradhiyon dvara mritak ka shav lekar pharar rahne ka sanasnikhej mamla samne aaya hai. is ghatna ke bad purniya ke sansad pappu yadav hajipur pahunche aur shok santapt parijnon se mulakat kar unhen dhandhas bandhaya.
